faq.question: Which EV is well suited for city driving?
faq.answer: City picks weigh maneuverability, commuter persona fit, and urban range practicality from catalog scores.

faq.question: Is ARAI range enough for city use?
faq.answer: Use real-world range bands in our catalog where available — city traffic often differs from lab cycles.

faq.question: What is the top pick on this page?
faq.answer: Tata XZ+ is currently highest on our best city india composite (score 86, high confidence). This is not a universal "best EV" claim — review tradeoffs below.

faq.question: What is the ex-showroom price of Tata XZ+?
faq.answer: Indicative ex-showroom from catalog: ₹11.99 lakh. Confirm on-road price with a dealer in your city.
